text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I am... so sorry. To have ended up with a 
result that betrays your trust...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
choice_data_list: I'll always be watching your runs, Still.

Let's keep working hard so you can run the 
way you want to!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Yes, Trainer. As long as you are 
watching over me—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"As the person I strive to be... I will 
definitely seize victory."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Could I have some of your time for 
training now?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"Together with you... I will draw closer 
to the form I desire to be."
